states.noDrives: No drives were returned for this vehicle.
states.telemetryErrorPassive: Selected-drive telemetry is unavailable; retry from the status above.
states.telemetryRefreshError: Drive telemetry could not refresh. Showing the most recently loaded fingerprint and evidence.
states.telemetryPending: Selected-drive telemetry availability has not resolved.
states.noTelemetry: This drive returned no telemetry emissions.
states.invalidTimestamps: Telemetry rows were returned, but none had a valid timestamp.
states.oneEmission: One chronological emission is available; at least two are needed for this profile.

kpis.title: Selected-drive evidence
kpis.regenShareHint: Power-available rows after forward fold, not time share
kpis.capReached: The selector reached its 1,000-drive history cap; this selected drive’s telemetry remains complete for that drive.

fingerprint.title: Emission fingerprint
fingerprint.subtitle: A deterministic visual encoding of observed telemetry emissions—not a score or personality assessment.
fingerprint.artAlt: Drive DNA deterministic emission artwork, signature {{signature}}
fingerprint.neutralChannels: Unavailable speed or power channels use neutral geometry and color; they are not encoded as measured zero.
fingerprint.artBound: Artwork uses {{encoded}} deterministic representative emissions from {{source}} valid rows; the signature uses all valid rows.

genome.title: Genome identity
genome.subtitle: The signature and traits are reproducible artistic encodings of this returned telemetry—not a driving grade.
genome.noTraits: No artistic trait was assigned; unavailable speed or power never creates a substitute trait.

encoding.title: Encoding legend & evidence
encoding.subtitle: Each available channel is normalized only for artwork geometry; canonical measurements remain unchanged in the analytical model.

profile.title: Speed & power emission profile
profile.subtitle: Chronological emissions at their actual elapsed positions; gaps are not interpolated into uniform samples.
profile.aria: Speed and signed pack power across elapsed selected-drive telemetry emissions
profile.speedUnavailable: Speed is unavailable; only measured power emissions are shown.
profile.powerUnavailable: Power is unavailable; only measured speed emissions are shown.
profile.noChannels: Speed and power channels are unavailable for these emissions.

context.title: SoC & elevation context
context.subtitle: Optional context at irregular emission timestamps; elevation is shown in metres because no elevation display preference exists.
context.aria: State of charge percentage and measured elevation across elapsed selected-drive emissions
context.socUnavailable: SoC is unavailable; only measured elevation context is shown.
context.elevationUnavailable: Elevation is unavailable for this drive; available SoC context remains visible.
context.noChannels: SoC and elevation channels are unavailable for these emissions.

powerStates.title: Power states by telemetry-emission count
powerStates.subtitle: Counts use a ±{{threshold}} {{unit}} coast band and are not duration or time shares.
powerStates.aria: Power-available telemetry emission counts classified as propulsion, coast, or regen observed
powerStates.empty: No emissions contain available power, so no power state is inferred.

speedBands.title: Speed bands by telemetry-emission count
speedBands.subtitle: Every speed-available emission contributes one count; bands are not duration or time shares.
speedBands.aria: Speed-available telemetry emission counts grouped into display-unit speed bands
speedBands.empty: No emissions contain available speed, so no speed band is inferred.

distributions.aria: Bar chart of drive DNA signal distribution
distributions.title: Drive DNA distribution

coverage.title: Signal coverage & cadence
coverage.subtitle: Availability means a value was present after StateReader forward-folding at an emission; it does not prove a fresh measurement on every row.
coverage.invalidOnly: All returned rows were excluded from the analytical timeline because their timestamps were invalid.
coverage.noRows: No telemetry rows were returned for cadence or channel coverage.
coverage.timestampWarning: Invalid timestamps are excluded; duplicate timestamps are retained as separate emissions and reported explicitly.
coverage.partialWarning: Partial channels remain unavailable rather than being replaced with measured zero.
coverage.gapWarning: The largest emission gap is more than three times the median interval; emission counts must not be interpreted as time shares.

method.title: Coverage & methodology
method.subtitle: Scope, signal semantics, and limits for interpreting this deterministic artwork.
method.capLoading: The selector is requesting up to {{limit}} recent drives.
method.capError: Selector history is unavailable; no returned-history coverage claim is made.
method.capReached: The selector returned the newest {{limit}} drives and reached its cap; older drives may not be selectable.
method.capScope: The selector requests up to {{limit}} recent drives; {{returned}} were returned for the current vehicle.
method.capPending: Selector-history availability has not resolved, so coverage is not yet known.
method.scopeSelector: The 1,000-drive cap qualifies only which drives can appear in the selector.
method.scopeTelemetry: The selected drive’s telemetry endpoint returns that drive’s full available emission feed and is not truncated by the selector cap.
method.scopeOptional: Elevation and other optional channels may be unavailable; missing values remain unavailable, never measured zero.
method.chartBound: Charts use at most {{limit}} deterministic points while retaining the first and last; evidence metrics use all valid rows.
method.changeFeed: Rows are chronological change-feed emissions with values forward-folded by StateReader, not uniform-time samples.
method.powerBoundary: The legacy response power value is kW and is multiplied by exactly 1,000 once at the model boundary to canonical W.
method.countBasis: Power states, speed bands, and regen shares are emission-count evidence, never duration or time shares.
method.noClaim: Traits are deterministic artistic heuristics—not a score, diagnosis, stable personality assessment, efficiency verdict, or causal claim.

driveDna.socElevationAria: State of charge and elevation over elapsed drive time
driveDna.speedPowerAria: Speed and motor power over elapsed drive time

brief.cadenceScope: Returned drive telemetry; valid timestamps define the observed span and adjacent-emission intervals.
brief.coverageDenominator: Availability is measured against {{count}} valid timestamp rows, not expected emissions.
brief.coverageScope: Per-signal availability in returned telemetry; missing readings are not zero measurements.
